text:
The 10-23 title lesson covers PROCESS words too, not only medium words: a source titled "Day in the Life of Casting a
Bell, Part 2" failed both clip scenes in about a minute ("the scene recipe names "casting" (the source's title or
channel)"), since any frame of a pour makes the recipe say casting. Title a video source by its series or episode label only
("S1 EP2, Part 2") and put the subject in `why`; a source's title can't be changed after add-source, so a bad title costs
every scene drawn from it. This argues for the same change in lib/foundry/scout/scene.ts.
